name: Bioaqua Pink Magic Nenhong Cream 30g
description:
Bioaqua Pink Magic Nenhong Cream – 30g
Origin: Made in Korea

Key Features & Benefits:

Natural Cherry Blossom Extract: Rich in cherry blossom peptides and vitamins, providing safe, mild, and skin-friendly care without side effects.

Moisturizes & Brightens: Helps soften and tenderize skin, reduce melanin, and promote a rosy, radiant appearance.

Multi-Purpose Care: Can be used on lips, areola, armpits, and other intimate areas to maintain smooth and glowing skin.

Gentle & Safe: Suitable for most skin types and ideal for daily use anywhere, anytime.

Lip Care Option: Doubles as a nourishing lip cream for soft and pink lips.
